top_signals.summary: ZachXBT's investigation traced $282 million in stolen Bitcoin through Tornado Cash, involving cross-chain hops from Bitcoin to Ethereum mixers and Monero spikes. Separately, Makina Finance lost $5 million in a flash loan exploit on its DUSD/USDC pool, as confirmed by CertiK.
